sweep.notes: Bash tool was broken in this session (unexpected EOF on every call), so I worked through PowerShell wrappers around ng.py and match.py. Only Meny (NorgesGruppen) was read. I did not read Oda, Coop, Rema or kassal.app, so Coop and Rema own-brand ice cream is unchecked. The database holds roughly 15 Hennig-Olsen, 20 Diplom-Is, 15 Ben & Jerry's and Magnum rows, and most carry the right numbers. The main problems are names that hide the flavour (Ben&Jerry's, Mövenpick, Magnum Is, Royal Is), different recipes folded under one barcode (Ben & Jerry's Strawberry Cheesecake and Caramel Brownie Party under Chocolate Fudge Brownie; Magnum Småis White Chocolate Strawberry under La Pistache; Mövenpick Pistachio under Maple Walnut; Bonbon Salted Caramel under Gold Caramel; Sørlandsis Ekte Vanilje 1 L under Sjokolade), duplicate rows, and a few missing products. Some chain-specific barcodes (Hennig-Olsen 6-packs, Lollipop 10 and 12 packs) already map to the single-pack row, which is correct. Not done: Coop and Rema own-brand ice cream, Kiwi, Oda. The database has 'Coop Krone-is' and 'Coop Karamellis' but I did not verify them against a store.
